title: Euclidean structures on simplicial surfaces and hyperbolic volume
note: The total hyperbolic-volume functional is strictly concave on the angle-structure polytope, and the complete hyperbolic structure is its unique critical point (maximum) — the source theorem for the `qou-krvm` hypothesis (iv). The single-tetrahedron analytic core is formalized sorry-free in `QOU.Archimedean.tetVol_strictConcaveOn` (concavity of $\Lambda(\alpha)+\Lambda(\beta)+\Lambda(\pi-\alpha-\beta)$ on the angle simplex); the geometric identification of that sum with the manifold volume is bean qou-idvt T2 (open). The 1994 Annals text itself is paywalled (not read in-repo); cited bibliographically for the theorem statement.
